title: Rotted cross-repo citations and worked examples in the standard and specs
cluster_summary: Root cause: the standard has no citation-form rule, so present-tense file:line citations and counts rot with every release, and dev-copilot's worked examples copy the same habit. The single best fix is one WowAddonStandards pass. It adds a documentation SHOULD (present-tense claims cite a symbol or heading; historical claims pin Repo@sha:path:line), converts the broken citations to that form instead of renumbering them, past-tenses or deletes the claims that are now false (LSMPatch, Schema.lua:1553), and folds in WAS-A-10, WAS-R-09, AT-A-14 and LK-A-08. dev-copilot gets a companion commit, scoped to the worked examples that steer generated output. Do not do a full recount.

verdicts.assessment: Verified. Several citations point at code that does not exist (Schema.lua:1553 in a 1392-line file; 'five addons ship core/LSMPatch.lua' when none does). The standard is the input to every audit and scaffold, so its errors spread. Renumbering alone would rot again, so the root-cause rule is what makes the fix stick.
verdicts.remediation: Add a citation SHOULD to documentation.md: present-tense claims cite a symbol or heading, and historical claims use Repo@sha:path:line. Convert the 49 broken citations to symbol/heading form or SHA-pin them, and past-tense or delete the 6 gone claims. Do it in one WAS commit that also absorbs WAS-A-10, WAS-R-09, AT-A-14 and the LK-A-08 sentence.

verdicts.assessment: Verified: BankLedger modules/Browser.lua:98 is a '--' comment line, and B:MakeCloseButton is at :103. It is the only file:line in an executed playbook, and every BankLedger audit reads it. standalone-windows.md:34 carries the same stale cite. Medium is overstated, since the function is easy to find, so low.
verdicts.remediation: Cite `B:MakeCloseButton` (BankLedger modules/Browser.lua) by symbol in both AUDIT.md:523 and standalone-windows.md:34. Include it in the WAS-A-09 commit.

verdicts.assessment: The counts drift with each release, so recounting is busywork that will recur. Only a few items actually mislead: the PrettyChat splitter path, which now lives in tools/, the EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY 'all eleven' against 'nine of nine' self-contradiction, and the 'eight addons pin CRLF' figure.
verdicts.remediation: Fix the PrettyChat splitter text in layout.md (tools/split_globalstrings.py; retire it as a known instance), the EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY contradiction, and the CRLF count. Reword other present-tense counts as rules ('every addon ...') or date them ('as measured at 2026-10-07'). In history files, add date stamps only. No full recount.

verdicts.assessment: Verified ('revision 24 ships today' when Kit.VERSION is 37, and a 4-of-22 kit file list). The authority is documentation-§5 sync, not the CLAUDE.md doc-set-count rule. A cheap wording fix that will not rot.
verdicts.remediation: testing.md:292 -> 'LibKa0s test-kit revision 24 and later ship this'. In testing.md:20 and NEW_ADDON_CONTEXT.md:1019, describe the _kit/ folder as vendored whole and unedited from LibKa0s testkit/ instead of listing files. Include it in the WAS-A-09 commit.

verdicts.assessment: toc-file.md:171 cites AbsorbTracker.toc:35-42, but the block runs from :37 ('# Core (the LibKa0s-Env seam loads first)') through :44 (core\Constants.lua), so the proposed :37-43 is also wrong. The fix lives in the standard; nothing changes in AbsorbTracker. The WAS-A-09 pass makes it mechanical.
verdicts.remediation: In toc-file.md:171, cite the block by its '# Core (the LibKa0s-Env seam loads first)' heading (or AbsorbTracker.toc@sha:37-44). Do it in the WAS-A-09 commit, with no AbsorbTracker change.

verdicts.assessment: The stale line number is cosmetic. The real gap is that the dependency sentence names two of the three attach files that floor on Pool and omits OptionsNav.lua, which misleads anyone reasoning about the Pool floor or load order. It is a defect in the standard, so nothing changes in LibKa0s.
verdicts.remediation: In library-stack.md (Inter-module dependencies), cite the NEEDS_POOL floor by symbol and name all three files: OptionsWidgets.lua, OptionsTabs.lua and OptionsNav.lua. Include it in the WAS-A-09 commit.

verdicts.assessment: Mostly confirmed, and these are executable instructions, so wrong examples steer output. The luacheckrc evidence was misstated and has been re-checked: every addon excludes libs/ (PrettyChat as libs/Libs), the ten with a kit exclude tests/_kit/, and none excludes all of tests/. So 'libs/ and tests/' is half wrong, not 0/11. The C.LSMValues example is dead (it moved to OptionsSetup.lua), the perf-skipper count is wrong, and the 359 SLASH_ figure is unscoped and stale.
verdicts.remediation: wow-revendor-libka0s.md:322 -> 'libs/ and tests/_kit/'. Fix the perf-skipper claim in agent-review.md/bump-version.md. Replace the dead C.LSMValues example with the current location (by symbol). Give the 359 SLASH_ figure its command and scope, or drop it. Convert the remaining file:line examples (LootHistory Compat.lua, OptionsCompose.lua, PrettyChat sizes) to symbol citations or 'as of <SHA>'. Do not re-derive line numbers.
